Глутамин.about: Conditionally essential amino acid; in intensive care, the effect is controversial; there are no data on outcomes for sports/muscles.
Глутамин.caution: For critical care (ICU, burns): Cochrane shows CLEAR effect - some RCTs are positive, others are not. For prematurity: Cochrane showed no benefit. For sports/immunity after exercise: no systematic data with clinical outcomes. It is safe orally, but the effect is questionable outside the ICU.
effects: Muscles: not confirmed; gut/immunity - only in the clinic
Глутамин.food_sources: Red meat, poultry, fish, milk, yogurt, legumes are the main sources; With normal nutrition there is no deficiency.
Глутамин.guidelines: 2024 MA (clinical): benefit is controversial and varies by group; 2024 MA (perioperative immunonutrition): complications below. Healthy people - no effect.
Глутамин.how_to_choose: Not necessary for healthy people with adequate nutrition; In the clinic, use medications as prescribed by your doctor, not dietary supplements.
mechs: Conditionally essential: fuel of enterocytes and lymphocytes
Muscles: not confirmed; gut/immunity - only in the clinic
Early RCT: fewer infections; 2 large RCTs did not confirm benefit (Cochrane 2014)
Metabolic fuel of enterocytes and lymphocytes in newborns
Prematures: no difference in infections and weight gain (Cochrane 2001)
Глутамин.myths: “Conditionally irreplaceable = everyone” - the clinical benefit is controversial (2024 MA). “For muscles” - no RCT.
Глутамин.name: Glutamine
Глутамин.onset: There is no immediate effect; in the clinic for days to weeks, the benefit was not confirmed in large RCTs.
Глутамин.title: Glutamine
Глутамин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Глутамин.who_needs: Only in the clinic as conditionally indispensable in critical conditions (as prescribed); healthy - not indicated, no benefit.
